servinfo.title: Passenger Air Bag Deactivation Indicator Inspection (If Equipped)

ptxt.intxrefpoff: Passenger Air Bag Deactivation Indicator Removal and Installation (If Equipped)

s1.ptxt: Remove passenger air bag deactivation indicator.
Check “PASSENGER AIR BAG OFF” and “PASSENGER AIR BAG ON” indicators as follows. If any faulty condition is found, replace hazard switch.

s2.ptxt: Connect battery positive (+) terminal to terminal “9” and negative (–) terminal to terminal “10” as shown.
Check that “PASSENGER AIR BAG OFF” indicator (1) lights up.
Connect battery positive (+) terminal to terminal “4” and check that “PASSENGER AIR BAG OFF” indicator reduces an illumination.
Connect battery positive (+) terminal to terminal “9” and negative (–) terminal to terminal “3” as shown.
Check that “PASSENGER AIR BAG ON” indicator (1) lights up.
Connect battery positive (+) terminal to terminal “4” and check that “PASSENGER AIR BAG ON” indicator reduces an illumination.
